titulo: Placement from PDF as a trial (applies, verifies and reverts)
estado_inicial: Disposable LOCAL copy, not workshared, of an authorized public or synthetic model (e.g. an Autodesk sample) with named straight grids and a OneLevelBased lighting fixture family loaded. Revit 2024 with BIMBRIDGE 0.9.0 installed; config.json levels RPW, lab profile with the copy's folder in laboratorio.carpetas and carpetas_documentos with the test PDF folder. NEVER the user's working model.

pasos.nombre: plan with the ops from the PDF workflow
